## Summary

Added many-to-many category/tag support to items, following the existing Item resource patterns:

- **`models.py`**: `Category`/`CategoryBase`/`CategoryCreate`/`CategoryPublic`/`CategoriesPublic`, plus `ItemCategoryLink` (composite-PK link table). `ItemCreate` gained `category_ids: list[uuid.UUID] = []`; `ItemPublic` gained `categories: list[CategoryPublic] = []`.
- **`crud.py`**: added `create_category`, and updated `create_item` to attach categories by ID.
- **`api/routes/categories.py`** (new): `GET/POST /categories/`, `DELETE /categories/{id}`, gated by `Depends(get_current_user)` at the router level (categories are a shared resource, not owned per-user like items, so there's no ownership check to perform — mirroring how `utils.py`'s auth-gate-only endpoint is structured).
- **`api/routes/items.py`**: item creation now looks up and attaches categories by the given IDs.
- **`api/main.py`**: registered the categories router.
- **Migration** `162c76b9ab5c_add_category_and_item_category_link.py`: the target Postgres instance already had `category`/`itemcategorylink` tables pre-applied under this exact revision id (not yet in our chain) — I wrote the migration to match that live schema exactly and verified with `alembic check` that it produces zero autogenerate diff against the models.
